profile_text.body:
Writesonic is a software company whose platform is described on its own site as an "AI Search Growth Engine" focused on helping brands gain visibility in AI-generated search results. The platform tracks performance across 10 AI platforms and more than 50 markets, drawing on what the company describes as a dataset of 2 billion or more real AI conversations updated weekly. It positions itself as serving customers including Amazon, Unilever, Acer, and NP Digital.

The core product combines generative engine optimization (GEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), and AI visibility tracking in a single platform. Features include an AI agent that rewrites pages to add FAQ blocks, comparison tables, and passages suited for AI citation, as well as tools to audit technical issues such as robots.txt, schema, and crawler errors from bots including GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot. The company also offers third-party citation outreach, product-level tracking for ChatGPT Shopping integrations, white-label reporting for agencies, and lift measurement at 14-day and 28-day intervals covering citation share, traffic, conversions, and pipeline.

The site's held facts classify Writesonic under the writing and editing category with a note describing its original focus as marketing copy, reflecting an earlier product positioning that the company's current messaging has moved away from in favor of AI search optimization. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
